subtasks.description: Define one login/refresh/reset/verification/session-family contract; remove legacy auth from public runtime composition.
subtasks.progress_note: Single v1 contract documented in docs/architecture/auth-session-contract.md (identities, session family, rotation/replay, revocation, cookies/CSRF, one-time tokens, gaps for T02). Legacy auth stack (backend/auth, middleware/auth.py, routers/auth.py) and ENABLE_LEGACY_API composition removed; guard test pins it. Verified: 115 passed on PostgreSQL. Product commit 4a97c04d.

subtasks.description: Test rotation/reuse, logout, password-reset invalidation, disabled users, account linking, cookies and CSRF.
subtasks.progress_note: Negative suite for the contract: OTP challenge binding/supersession (request_otp now invalidates open challenges), cookie attributes incl. Secure/Domain, Google link auth requirement, no silent account merge, no double-linking. 121 passed on PostgreSQL. Live provider flows blocked_external. Product commit 7b9e992f.

subtasks.description: Add organization/team/agent assignments with effective dates and a written role/resource permission matrix.
subtasks.progress_note: Matrix written and machine-checked (product docs/security/authorization-matrix.md + test_authorization_matrix.py: permission grants, grant hierarchy, full route inventory with deny-by-default). Policy centralised in backend/security/authorization.py; admin routes moved to explicit workspace:manage. Memberships carry valid_from/valid_until (enforced per request). Teams + effective-dated, revocable supervisor/agent assignments; Workspace.record_scope=team restricts member/viewer reads on every meeting path; attribution escalations refused. Migration 9b1d4f2c7a35 verified on PostgreSQL (upgrade/check/downgrade/upgrade). 130 passed on PostgreSQL 16.15. Deferred: organization-level assignments (no organization actor exists; documented as deny) and analyst/executive roles (F06). Product commit 06dd9a0f.

subtasks.description: Enforce tenant and record scope in repositories, objects, jobs, exports, shares, retrieval and later projections.
subtasks.progress_note: API/object scope: static route audit (all v1 routes gated; public share page token-addressed) + two-tenant negative suite test_tenant_scope.py (14 operations × 2 header strategies) on PostgreSQL. Search/retrieval scoping covered by test_insights_shares_api. PostgreSQL RLS is T05. Product commit 3f91279a.

subtasks.description: Add PostgreSQL RLS under a non-bypass application role; set tenant context transaction-locally and test pooled-connection reuse.
subtasks.progress_note: Migration c4e8b2a7d519 creates NOLOGIN homayar_app (no superuser/BYPASSRLS), grants DML and installs FORCEd policies on 25 tenant tables (backend/database/rls.py). Context bound per transaction via set_config(..., true) from validated session/membership/job/token (backend/database/tenant_context.py); no default tenant. Runtime role via DATABASE_APP_ROLE (SET ROLE on checkout) or direct login member; production refuses superuser/BYPASSRLS. Whole suite runs as homayar_app: 135 passed on PostgreSQL 16.15; test_row_level_security.py covers a LOGIN probe role (cross-tenant read/insert/update/re-home, missing/stale/rollback context, pooled reuse, job scope, FORCE on a non-superuser owner, posture check, API flow without SET ROLE). Migration verified upgrade/check/downgrade/upgrade. Not verified: PgBouncer transaction pooling and managed-provider role provisioning (documented in deployment.md). Product commit 55bb6085.

subtasks.description: Add explicit recipient/organization share policies, revocation and short-lived download authorization.
Build adversarial two-tenant/two-team tests including background jobs, guessed IDs, stale tokens and changed membership.
subtasks.progress_note: Covered: guessed ids, foreign workspace header, membership deactivated with a still-valid session (per-request check), background job writes only into the owning workspace. Two-team/role-matrix cases added with T03 (test_authorization_matrix.py). Missing: stale API-key cases (WP16). Product commits 3bf703f9, 06dd9a0f.
